answer: A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the tundra is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
